title: The promised land and its multitudes
summary: The angel directs Nephi to look at the land of promise and the multitudes of his seed and his brothers’ seed.
characters: multitudes of Nephi’s seed and his brothers’ seed

explicit_facts.text: The angel tells Nephi to look at his seed and his brothers’ seed.
Nephi sees the land of promise and multitudes of people, as numerous as the sand of the sea.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi and the angel observe a vision of the land and its people.
unspecified_visual_details: The angel’s appearance, Nephi’s appearance, the people’s clothing, and the land’s specific features are not described.

spoken_dialogue.text: Look, and behold thy seed, and also the seed of thy brethren.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: the angel

narration.text: I looked and beheld the land of promise;

prohibited_inventions: Do not identify the multitudes with later named peoples or invent distinguishing traits.

title: War among the multitudes
summary: Nephi sees multitudes battle, wars and slaughters among his people, generations pass amid conflict, and many cities.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi sees multitudes gathered to battle one another, wars, rumors of wars, and great slaughters with the sword among his people.
Nephi sees many generations pass amid wars and contentions in the land, and many cities.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The passage of generations and the many cities may be conveyed as a vision montage.
unspecified_visual_details: The cities’ designs, the people’s identities and clothing, and the appearance of combat are unspecified.

narration.text: I beheld multitudes gathered together to battle, one against the other;
I beheld many generations pass away, after the manner of wars and contentions in the land;

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Wars and rumors of wars are both reported; do not depict rumors as a separate visible event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict specific named combatants, leaders, or cities.

title: Tumult in the land
summary: Nephi sees darkness, natural upheaval, and cities sinking, burning, or falling during the quaking.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi sees a mist of darkness, lightning, and the effects of thunder, earthquakes, and tumultuous noises; the earth and rocks rend, mountains tumble into pieces, plains break up, and cities sink, burn, or tumble to the earth because of the quaking.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A broad view may show the described destruction across the land.
unspecified_visual_details: The number and design of cities, the specific landscape, and any people present are not specified.

narration.text: I saw the earth and the rocks, that they rent;
I saw mountains tumbling into pieces;
I saw many cities that they were sunk;

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Depict only the narrated upheaval; the chapter does not identify its cause beyond the quaking.
prohibited_inventions: Do not add specific victims, buildings, fire sources, or supernatural figures.

title: The darkness passes
summary: The vapor of darkness passes from the earth, and Nephi sees multitudes who have not fallen in the judgments.

explicit_facts.text: After the preceding events, Nephi sees the vapor of darkness pass from the earth and sees multitudes who had not fallen because of the great and terrible judgments of the Lord.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The scene can show the darkness clearing and the surviving multitudes.
unspecified_visual_details: The survivors’ identities, condition, clothing, and surroundings are unspecified.

narration.text: I saw the vapor of darkness, that it passed from off the face of the earth;

prohibited_inventions: Do not portray a particular judgment or individual survivor not described here.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi sees the heavens open and the Lamb of God descending out of heaven; the Lamb comes down and shows himself to the multitudes.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The Lamb may be shown descending from an opened heaven toward the multitudes.
unspecified_visual_details: The Lamb’s physical appearance, the multitudes’ individual identities, and the precise setting below are not described.

summary: The Holy Ghost falls upon twelve others, who are ordained and chosen; the angel identifies them as disciples chosen to minister to Nephi’s seed.

title: The disciples and the twelve apostles
summary: The angel explains that the twelve apostles of the Lamb will judge the twelve tribes of Israel, and the twelve ministers of Nephi’s seed will be judged by them.

title: The ministers’ righteousness
summary: The angel tells Nephi that the twelve ministers he sees will judge his seed and are righteous forever because of their faith in the Lamb of God.

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict blood or a literal garment-whitening process.

summary: Nephi sees three generations pass in righteousness, with white garments; the angel explains that they are made white through faith in the Lamb.

title: The fountain and river explained
summary: The angel identifies the fountain of filthy water as the river Nephi’s father saw, and explains the meanings of its depths and the mists of darkness.

explicit_facts.text: The angel identifies the fountain of filthy water with the river Nephi’s father saw and says its depths are the depths of hell.
The angel says the mists of darkness are the devil’s temptations, which blind eyes, harden hearts, and lead people onto broad roads where they perish and are lost.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The angel’s teaching may be presented as off-screen speech over a neutral vision setting.
unspecified_visual_details: The angel’s appearance and whether the fountain, river, or mists are visible during the explanation are unspecified.

title: The building and the gulf explained
summary: The angel explains the large and spacious building as vain imaginations and pride, and the great gulf as the word of God’s justice and the Messiah, of whom the Holy Ghost bears record.

explicit_facts.text: The angel says the large and spacious building represents vain imaginations and human pride; a great and terrible gulf divides them from the word of God’s justice and the Messiah, the Lamb of God, of whom the Holy Ghost bears record.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The angel’s teaching may be shown as off-screen speech rather than a literal scene of the symbolic building or gulf.
unspecified_visual_details: The appearance of the building, gulf, Messiah, and Holy Ghost is not described in this verse.
